reviews.reason: HOLD: contradictory relationship attribution. Membership is otherwise supported: p079 (s0118 「初，遣大將劉悟屯陽谷」), p086 (s0126 「初，師古見劉悟」) and the anchor jiutangshu:181:p007 (s0007 「師道窮蹙，劉悟斬首投魏軍」) are the same Liu Wu. However, p086's relationship claim feud-with p089 (Lady Wei) at s0129 contradicts 「悟素與師道妻魏亂」: 與…亂 means Liu Wu had long had an illicit liaison with Shidao's wife Lady Wei, not a feud. The sentence goes on to say he falsely declared her a descendant of 鄭公征, so she was not executed but confiscated into the palace women's quarters (沒入掖廷). Proposed correction: replace feud-with with an explicit illicit-liaison relationship, and repair s0129 in both English fields (supplemental omission artifact).

HOLD: invented fact attributed to the person. Membership is supported: p028 (s0038 「子師古、師道」, s0039 「師古，以蔭累署青州刺史」) and p085 (s0126 「初，師古見劉悟」) are both Li Shigu. However, p028 carries a status claim {ill, near-death} at s0044 drawn from 「師古殆襲，武俊易其弱，且納時將無在」. Here 襲 means succession to his father's command. The context confirms this: Na had just died (s0040), Wujun thought the new heir weak, and Na's veteran generals were gone. Shigu remains active through s0045-s0055 and dies early in Yuanhe. No illness or near-death is stated; the current English 'near death' / 'gravely ill' mistranslates the line. Proposed correction: retract the status claim (optionally record that he had newly succeeded), and repair s0044 in both English fields (supplemental omission artifact). Cross-chapter Li Shigu candidates stay unresolved.
